title: artemisia camphorata var. alpestris
intro: Artemisia camphorata var. alpestris, commonly known as Mongolian wormwood, is a plant species native to Asia that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Mongolian wormwood are attributed to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe pain, reduce swelling, and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, such as borneol, camphor, and thujone, which exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
